title: Ruth Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Ruth 1: Naomi's family in Moab, Ruth's loyalty, and the return to Bethlehem.

questions.text: Why did the man of Bethlehem Judah go to live in Moab?
questions.explanation: In the days when the judges judged, there was a famine in the land, so a man of Bethlehem Judah went to live in Moab with his wife and two sons.

answers.text: There was a famine in the land

questions.text: What were the names of Elimelech's two sons?
questions.explanation: The names of his two sons were Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Bethlehem Judah.

questions.text: What were the names of the Moabite women the two sons married?
questions.explanation: They took wives of the women of Moab; the name of one was Orpah and the other Ruth.

questions.text: About how long did the family live in Moab?
questions.explanation: The text says they lived there about ten years.

questions.text: What news made Naomi decide to return from Moab?
questions.explanation: She had heard in Moab how Yahweh had visited his people in giving them bread.

answers.text: Her husband's brother had sent for her
Yahweh had given his people bread
The Moabites wanted her to leave
Her land in Bethlehem had been sold

questions.text: What did Orpah do when Naomi urged her daughters-in-law to go back?
questions.explanation: They wept again; then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

answers.text: She went on with Naomi to Bethlehem
She asked Ruth to stay in Moab

questions.text: Complete Ruth's words: "Your people will be my people, and..."
questions.explanation: Ruth said, "Your people will be my people, and your God my God."

questions.text: What did Naomi ask the women of Bethlehem to call her?
questions.explanation: She said, "Don't call me Naomi. Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt very bitterly with me."

questions.text: Complete Naomi's words: "I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again..."
questions.explanation: Naomi said, "I went out full, and Yahweh has brought me home again empty."

questions.text: At what time of year did Naomi and Ruth come to Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

answers.text: At the end of wheat harvest
At the beginning of barley harvest
